data.long_meaning: Ajaj is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'warrior' or 'conqueror'. It is a powerful name for a boy and is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and brave. The name Ajaj carries the meaning “Warrior, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ajaj usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
